name: Earth's energy imbalance (derived here from ocean heat)
institution: DERIVED BY THIS PROJECT from NOAA NCEI ocean heat content
note: NOT AN OBSERVATION - this is our own calculation, shown because no keyless observed series exists. A 10-year trailing least-squares trend through NOAA's 0-2000 m ocean heat content, divided by the ocean's 0.89 share of the Earth heat inventory (von Schuckmann et al. 2020) and by Earth's surface area. It runs LOW because the ocean below 2000 m is not in the input, and it lags a real turn by up to the window length. Published estimates are near 0.9 to 1.0 W/m2 for recent years.
